parameters.formula: R = (sum_{k in O} w_k s_k / sum_{k in O} w_k) * C^gamma ; C = sum_{k in O} w_k / sum_k w_k
parameters.kernel: s_v = exp(-(phi(x)-phi(y))^2 / (2 sigma_v^2)); interval distance when the experiment reports a range
parameters.missing_values: never imputed; unobserved component leaves O and lowers C; not_applicable does not lower C

excluded.reason: proxy for origin, not physics (review: sesgos, item 2)

notes: Initial weights, gamma and sigma_v are design hypotheses to be calibrated against expert judgments (nDCG@10). Replace with LambdaRank only if it beats this formula on a held-out set.
